answer: A violet of per-task receipts records who did what, and the canyon of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, reduced by each unverified claim, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. What survives to the reef is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
